description:
Perform a multivariate outlier analysis on the Exam Anxiety dataset. 

1. Open the file '/home/ga/Documents/JASP/ExamAnxiety.csv' in JASP.
2. Run a Linear Regression with 'Exam' as the Dependent Variable, and 'Anxiety' and 'Revise' as Covariates.
3. In the analysis options, under 'Save' (or 'Statistics' > 'Residuals' depending on version), enable 'Mahalanobis Distance' to calculate this metric for all cases. This will add a new column to the dataset.
4. Go to the Data view, examine the new 'Mahalanobis' column, and identify the student (row) with the HIGHEST Mahalanobis distance.
5. Create a text file at '/home/ga/Documents/JASP/outlier_report.txt' and write ONLY the student's 'Code' (ID number) into it.
6. Save the JASP project with the regression analysis and added data column to '/home/ga/Documents/JASP/OutlierAnalysis.jasp'.
